scope: Wuhan v8 storage-retrofit drainage network — recovery capability proof and event prescreen.
author: Project6 agent, Gate 3.5 Recovery Capability Proof

recovery_state_definitions.description: Five mutually exclusive recovery states, evaluated in order. First match wins.

states.label: Dry-weather baseline (DWF stable state)
states.description: System under DWF-only forcing with no rainfall. All hydraulic variables have reached a stable diurnal cycle or steady state.
criteria: PFV rate slope < system_volume_slope_tolerance for >= dry_baseline_stability_window
TFV rate slope < system_volume_slope_tolerance for >= dry_baseline_stability_window
System stored volume slope < system_volume_slope_tolerance for >= dry_baseline_stability_window
states.usage: Reference baseline for all recovery comparisons. Recovery is NOT defined as zero flooding — it is defined as return to this baseline band.

states.label: Event recession (post-rainfall drawdown)
states.description: Rainfall has ceased; system is draining. Flooding may still occur but is decreasing.
criteria: PFV and TFV are non-increasing (slope <= 0 over 30-min window)
System has not yet met complete recovery criteria
states.usage: Intermediate state. Recovery clock starts when recession begins.

states.label: Hydraulic stabilization (volume balance restoring)
states.description: System inflow and outflow are approaching balance; stored volume is decreasing toward baseline.
criteria: System stored volume is within 2x of dry-weather baseline mean
states.usage: Pre-recovery state. System is converging but has not yet met full recovery duration.

states.label: Complete recovery (returned to DWF baseline band)
states.description: All hydraulic variables have returned to within tolerance of the dry-weather baseline for a sustained period.
criteria: PFV incremental volume < PFV_tolerance for >= stable_recovery_duration
Priority flooding = 0 (no priority node flooding above baseline) for >= stable_recovery_duration
Node depths within node_depth_tolerance of DWF baseline for >= stable_recovery_duration
Storage volumes within storage_volume_tolerance of DWF baseline for >= stable_recovery_duration
System volume slope < system_volume_slope_tolerance for >= stable_recovery_duration
states.usage: Recovery is proven. Event is recovery-qualified.

states.label: Censored recovery (tail exceeded maximum without recovery)
states.description: Post-rainfall tail has exceeded maximum_tail without meeting complete recovery criteria.
criteria: Complete recovery criteria NOT met at any point during tail
states.usage: Event is censored. Can be used for H120-only stress testing but NOT for full-event recovery labels.

dry_baseline_duration.source: Engineering judgment — Wuhan large network needs extended DWF to stabilize from arbitrary initial conditions
dry_baseline_duration.description: Minimum DWF-only simulation duration to establish baseline

dry_baseline_stability_window.source: Must cover at least one full diurnal DWF cycle to confirm periodic stability
dry_baseline_stability_window.description: Continuous window over which all slope criteria must hold for baseline to be declared stable

PFV_tolerance.source: Priority flooding must not increase above DWF baseline; any incremental PFV is a violation
PFV_tolerance.description: Maximum allowable incremental Priority Flood Volume relative to DWF baseline

TFV_tolerance.source: Allow微量 flooding fluctuation from DWF numerical noise; based on SWMM DYNWAVE continuity tolerance
TFV_tolerance.description: Maximum allowable TFV rate above DWF baseline for recovery判定

priority_flooding_tolerance.source: Priority sentinel nodes must have zero incremental flooding for recovery
priority_flooding_tolerance.description: Maximum allowable flooding at priority sentinel nodes above DWF baseline

node_depth_tolerance.source: Engineering tolerance for node depth deviation from DWF baseline
node_depth_tolerance.description: Maximum allowable node depth deviation from DWF baseline mean

storage_volume_tolerance.source: Relative to maximum storage capacity; 1% allows minor level fluctuation
storage_volume_tolerance.description: Maximum allowable storage volume deviation from DWF baseline, as % of max capacity

system_volume_slope_tolerance.source: Linear regression slope of system stored volume over stability window
system_volume_slope_tolerance.description: Maximum allowable rate of change of total system stored volume

inflow_outflow_imbalance_tolerance.source: Ratio |inflow - outflow| / max(inflow, 1e-6); 5% allows minor DWF imbalance
inflow_outflow_imbalance_tolerance.description: Maximum allowable relative imbalance between total system inflow and outflow

stable_recovery_duration.source: Must sustain recovery conditions through at least half a diurnal cycle
stable_recovery_duration.description: Minimum continuous duration all recovery criteria must hold for complete recovery

minimum_tail.source: Minimum post-rainfall simulation tail for any recovery assessment
minimum_tail.description: Minimum post-rainfall simulation duration before recovery can be assessed

maximum_tail.source: 24 hours post-rainfall; beyond this, event is censored
maximum_tail.description: Maximum post-rainfall tail; if recovery not achieved by this time, event is censored

tail_extension_increment.source: Incremental extension step when recovery not yet achieved
tail_extension_increment.description: Post-rainfall tail is extended in this increment until maximum_tail is reached

censoring_rule.description: If post-rainfall tail > maximum_tail AND complete_recovery criteria never satisfied -> recovery_class = censored_stress, label_scope = h120_only, full_event_eligible = false

recovery_classification.R1_slow_recovery: Recovery achieved between minimum_tail and maximum_tail
recovery_classification.R2_censored: No recovery within maximum_tail; censored stress event
recovery_classification.R3_not_evaluated: Event not yet run or evaluation failed

dry_weather_baseline_protocol.rainfall: None — zero intensity timeseries or no rain gage active
dry_weather_baseline_protocol.DWF: All 538 DWF entries with hourly/daily patterns preserved
dry_weather_baseline_protocol.hotstart: FORBIDDEN — must start from standard initial conditions
dry_weather_baseline_protocol.duration: 72 hours minimum, or until 12-hour continuous stability achieved

recovery_prescreen_protocol.post_rain_tail: Extend from minimum_tail in tail_extension_increment steps up to maximum_tail
recovery_prescreen_protocol.recovery_judgment: Relative to dry-weather baseline, NOT absolute zero

inp_recovery_capability_criteria.description: All 10 conditions must be met to declare inp_recovery_capability_proven = true

criteria.description: Dry-weather baseline reaches stability (slope criteria met for >= stability_window)
At least one micro-rain event recovers under both No-control and Dynamic Internal
At least one light-rain event recovers under both references
At least one moderate-rain event recovers under both references
Recovery proven by PFV + TFV + Storage + system volume jointly
SWMM continuity error < continuity_error_max in all runs
Recession not caused by ponding loss (ponded area check)
Boundary conditions, DWF, and controls remain correct throughout tail
Deterministic: repeated runs produce identical results
No hotstart used in any prescreen run
